europe_now.title: Mass Unrest and Arrests Across France
europe_now.summary: Nationwide demonstrations in France have resulted in over 1,300 arrests following clashes during large protests. Authorities and political figures are responding to the escalating security situation as public mobilization continues.

sources.headline: At least 1,300 people arrested in mass weekend protests across France
More than 1,300 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France

europe_now.title: Electoral Contests in Eastern Europe
europe_now.summary: Citizens in Serbia and Bulgaria are heading to the polls for parliamentary and presidential elections amid significant regional issues. Early reports from Serbia indicate a record high turnout as voters participate in the ongoing electoral process.

sources.headline: Early reports suggest record high turnout in Serbia elections
Bulgaria holds presidential elections amid divisions over Ukraine war

top_stories.title: Civil Unrest in France
top_stories.summary: Authorities reported that more than 1,300 individuals were arrested following widespread weekend demonstrations and subsequent clashes across France. Far-right leader Marine Le Pen sought to leverage the ongoing unrest during her presidential campaign launch.

sources.headline: At least 1,300 people arrested in mass weekend protests across France

top_stories.title: Electoral Developments in Eastern Europe
top_stories.summary: Serbia held a parliamentary election featuring a populist leader facing a student movement alongside early reports of record high turnout. Meanwhile, Bulgaria conducted presidential elections amidst internal divisions regarding the ongoing conflict in Ukraine.
